# SharedAssociativeMemory

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A cross-entity memory module that stores and retrieves associative patterns shared among distributed HTM nodes, enabling collaborative learning and context-aware warnings. Facilitates cross-entity knowledge transfer and reduces redundant learning, critical for efficient topology-centric distributed intelligence.
